name: Google Did You Mean
look: A plain white mock-up of a Google search results page: the Google logo beside an empty search bar, tabs for All, Images, Videos, News, Maps and More, a line reading "About 815,000 results (0.39 seconds)", and a red "Did you mean:" followed by a blank.
use: Search for one thing and Google "corrects" it to something else. Type a query in the search bar and put the joke suggestion after "Did you mean:", revealing what the searcher really wants or what something really is.
slots: the search query (in the search bar)
examples: how to order pizza without guilt
describe: search results page that says did you mean in red
